gen.rule.dc.battery_min.desc: Minutes the batteries carry the full IT load until the generators take it.
gen.rule.dc.battery_min.title: Battery autonomy
gen.rule.dc.chiller_spare.desc: Chillers beyond those that carry the load (N+1 with 1).
gen.rule.dc.chiller_spare.title: Spare chillers
gen.rule.dc.chw_dt.desc: Temperature rise across the cooling units; sets the flow.
gen.rule.dc.chw_dt.title: Chilled water rise
gen.rule.dc.chw_v.desc: Most velocity in the pipes; the smallest size under it is taken.
gen.rule.dc.chw_v.title: Chilled water velocity
gen.rule.dc.cold_aisle.desc: Width between two rows whose fronts face each other.
gen.rule.dc.cold_aisle.title: Cold aisle
gen.rule.dc.contain.desc: Doors closing each cold aisle at both row ends; 0 leaves the aisles open.
gen.rule.dc.contain.title: Containment doors
gen.rule.dc.cooling_margin.desc: Heat added to the IT load for lights, fans, people and losses.
gen.rule.dc.cooling_margin.title: Cooling margin
gen.rule.dc.crah_clear.desc: Free space in front of the cooling units for service and air throw.
gen.rule.dc.crah_clear.title: Clearance before cooling units
gen.rule.dc.crah_spare.desc: Cooling units per hall beyond those that carry its heat (N+1 with 1).
gen.rule.dc.crah_spare.title: Spare cooling units
gen.rule.dc.crah_throw.desc: Farthest a cooling unit supplies air under the floor; rows run between the unit walls.
gen.rule.dc.crah_throw.title: Cooling unit throw
gen.rule.dc.cross_aisle.desc: Width of the aisle that breaks a long row.
gen.rule.dc.cross_aisle.title: Cross aisle
gen.rule.dc.facility_factor.desc: Facility peak load over the IT load that the generators carry.
gen.rule.dc.facility_factor.title: Facility load factor
gen.rule.dc.gen_spare.desc: Generators beyond those that carry the facility load (N+1 with 1).
gen.rule.dc.gen_spare.title: Spare generators
gen.rule.dc.hall_band.desc: Deepest band a brief with a data hall may ask for: the hall is lit by its lamps, not its facade.
gen.rule.dc.hall_band.title: Deepest data hall band
gen.rule.dc.hall_m2_rack.desc: Floor area to ask per rack, aisles and cooling unit walls included.
gen.rule.dc.hall_m2_rack.title: Hall area per rack
gen.rule.dc.hot_aisle.desc: Width between the backs of two rows.
gen.rule.dc.hot_aisle.title: Hot aisle
gen.rule.dc.pdu_ends.desc: Power distribution units at the row ends: 2 one per power path, 1 path A only, 0 none.
gen.rule.dc.pdu_ends.title: PDU row ends
gen.rule.dc.pipe_off.desc: Distance from the unit fronts to the chilled water headers.
gen.rule.dc.pipe_off.title: Header offset
gen.rule.dc.pipe_pitch.desc: Spacing of parallel pipes and trays, sideways and in height.
gen.rule.dc.pipe_pitch.title: Pipe spacing
gen.rule.dc.rack_kw.desc: Heat the halls reject and power the UPS and generators carry per rack.
gen.rule.dc.rack_kw.title: IT load per rack
gen.rule.dc.racks.desc: Racks shared over the data halls by what each holds; 0 fills every hall.
gen.rule.dc.racks.title: Racks asked
gen.rule.dc.raised_floor.desc: Racks stand on it; the chilled water runs in its void. 0 for a solid floor.
gen.rule.dc.raised_floor.title: Raised floor height
gen.rule.dc.row_end.desc: Free width between rows and walls, and at the hall ends for the mains.
gen.rule.dc.row_end.title: Row end clearance
gen.rule.dc.row_max.desc: Most racks in a row before a cross aisle.
gen.rule.dc.row_max.title: Racks per row
gen.rule.dc.tray_gap.desc: Clear height from the rack top to the trays.
gen.rule.dc.tray_gap.title: Tray clearance
gen.rule.dc.tray_h.desc: Side height of the cable trays.
gen.rule.dc.tray_h.title: Tray height
gen.rule.dc.tray_w.desc: Width of the cable trays over the rows and their trunks.
gen.rule.dc.tray_w.title: Tray width
gen.rule.dc.unit_front.desc: Free space in front of UPS, battery and chiller rows; spacing in the yard.
gen.rule.dc.unit_front.title: Service space before units
gen.rule.dc.unit_gap.desc: Gap between neighbouring units and around columns.
gen.rule.dc.unit_gap.title: Gap between units
gen.rule.dc.unit_step.desc: Step, as a share of a unit's width, by which a unit slides along its wall to clear columns.
gen.rule.dc.unit_step.title: Unit seating step
gen.rule.dc.ups_paths.desc: Independent UPS paths to the racks: 2 gives 2N.
gen.rule.dc.ups_paths.title: Power paths
gen.rule.dc.ups_spare.desc: UPS modules per path beyond those that carry the IT load.
gen.rule.dc.ups_spare.title: Spare UPS per path
gen.rule.dc.yard_gap.desc: Distance from the facade to the first row of yard units.
gen.rule.dc.yard_gap.title: Yard distance
gen.rule.dc.yard_side.desc: Side of the building with the generator yard and outdoor chillers.
gen.rule.dc.yard_side.title: Yard side
